title: OPC-UA Configuration
description: Configure OPC-UA server connections and node polling

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: OPC-UA servers to poll. Click 'Add' to add a server, or use Auto-configure to check the servers here (none: it looks for servers on this machine).

name.title: Name
name.description: Label this server appears under in the trace and the `server` parameter of the actions. Defaults to the endpoint host (e.g. plc01, 192_168_1_10); sanitized like node names.

node_map_file.title: Node Map File
node_map_file.description: JSON node map defining the nodes to poll. Leave empty to trace every variable the server exposes (Advanced > Discovery).
node_map_file.ui:help: JSON file mapping OPC-UA nodes to semantic events

poll_interval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
poll_interval.description: Sampling and publishing interval of this server's subscriptions, the poll period of anything polled, and the period of the _server health read. A node map event can set its own.

min_update_interval.title: Min Update Interval (seconds)
min_update_interval.description: Empty uses Advanced > Min Update Interval.

include.title: Discovery Include
include.description: Without a node map: browse paths to trace, as globs (`*` one segment, `**` any depth), e.g. ModbusTCP/PowerMeter/**. Branches no pattern can reach are not browsed. Empty uses Advanced > Discovery Include.

exclude.title: Discovery Exclude
exclude.description: Without a node map: browse paths not traced nor browsed below, as globs, e.g. **/Diagnostics. Wins over include. Empty uses Advanced > Discovery Exclude.

security_mode.title: Security Mode
security_mode.description: 'default' uses Advanced > Security Mode. None under a secure default is allowed and logged as a warning on every connect.

security_policy.title: Security Policy
security_policy.description: 'default' uses Advanced > Security Policy. Required when the security mode is not None.

user_certificate_file.title: User Certificate
user_certificate_file.description: X.509 user identity certificate (DER or PEM). Leave empty to use Advanced > User Certificate. Needs Sign or SignAndEncrypt.

user_private_key_file.title: User Private Key
user_private_key_file.description: Unencrypted private key (DER or PEM) for this server's user certificate. Set both or neither.

server_certificate.title: Server Certificate Policy
server_certificate.description: Which server certificates a Sign or SignAndEncrypt connection accepts. Trust list: those in the extension's pki/trusted folder; an unknown one is saved to pki/rejected and refused until you trust it (trust_server_certificate action, or move the file). Pinned file: only the certificate in Server Certificate File. Either way the certificate must be within its validity period and name the server's ApplicationUri.

server_certificate_file.title: Server Certificate File
server_certificate_file.description: With 'strict', the only server certificate accepted (DER or PEM).

allow_expired_server_certificate.title: Allow Expired Server Certificate
allow_expired_server_certificate.description: Connect even if the server's certificate has expired (or is not yet valid), with a warning on every connect. For a server whose certificate cannot be renewed yet.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Settings shared by every server, and the defaults a server inherits.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Leading trace source every server publishes under, so events read '<prefix>/<server>/<event>'. Clear it to give each server its own trace source with unprefixed events.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: For a server without a node map, browse it on every connect and trace every scalar variable found (read-only). Off: such a server polls nothing.

include.title: Discovery Include
include.description: Browse paths below Objects to trace, as globs over the BrowseNames sanitized as traced: `*` matches within one segment, `**` any number of segments (e.g. ModbusTCP/PowerMeter/**). Branches no pattern can reach are not browsed. Empty traces everything.

exclude.title: Discovery Exclude
exclude.description: Browse paths not traced, nor browsed below, as globs (e.g. **/Diagnostics). Wins over include.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: 'subscription': the server pushes value changes (monitored items), and anything it refuses (item or subscription limits) is polled for that connection with one warning. 'poll': batched Reads every interval for every node.

min_update_interval.title: Min Update Interval (seconds)
min_update_interval.description: With subscriptions, a node that reports nothing for this long (a static value, or a server that stopped reporting it) is re-read and logged at the server's read time.

certificate_file.title: Client Certificate
certificate_file.description: Client application certificate (DER or PEM). Leave empty to generate one in the extension data directory on the first secure connection and reuse it; trust that certificate on the server.

private_key_file.title: Client Private Key
private_key_file.description: Unencrypted private key (DER or PEM) for the client certificate. Set both or neither.

security_mode.title: Security Mode
security_mode.description: Default OPC-UA security mode for servers set to 'default'

security_policy.title: Security Policy
security_policy.description: Default OPC-UA security policy for servers set to 'default' (required when the security mode is not None)

user_certificate_file.title: User Certificate
user_certificate_file.description: Default X.509 user identity certificate (DER or PEM) issued by the server admin, who maps it to a user. Leave empty to connect as Anonymous. Needs Sign or SignAndEncrypt.

user_private_key_file.title: User Private Key
user_private_key_file.description: Unencrypted private key (DER or PEM) for the user certificate. Set both or neither.
